origin: From Latin specere 'to look at' (past stem spect-).

words.en: look over carefully
words.zh: 检查, 检阅, 检验；检查
words.why: in-(向内) + spect(看) → 往里看 → 检查

words.en: (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point; an attitude of admiration or esteem
words.zh: 尊敬, 尊重, 问候；尊敬, 注意, 遵守
words.why: re-(反复) + spect(看) → 反复注视 → 尊重

words.en: regard something as probable or likely; look forward to the probable occurrence of
words.zh: 预期, 盼望, 期待
words.why: ex-(向外) + spect(看) → 向外张望等候 → 期待

words.en: someone who is under suspicion
words.zh: 被怀疑者, 嫌疑犯；令人怀疑的, 不可信的, 可疑的；怀疑, 猜想
words.why: sus-(从下) + spect(看) → 从下偷看 → 怀疑

words.en: the possibility of future success
words.zh: 景色, 展望；勘探, 勘察；勘探, 有前途
words.why: pro-(向前) + spect(看) → 向前看 → 前景

words.en: a distinct feature or element in a problem; a characteristic to be considered
words.zh: 外观, 方面, 面貌, 方向；方面, 局面；外观
words.why: ad-(朝) + spect(看) → 朝某方向看的样子 → 方面

words.en: a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)
words.zh: 观众, 目击者, 旁观者
words.why: spect(看) + -ator(人) → 看的人 → 观众

words.en: something or someone seen (especially a notable or unusual sight); an elaborate and remarkable displ
words.zh: 引人羡慕的东西, 景象, 眼镜, 场面, 公开展示
words.why: spect(看) + -acle(物) → 供观看之物 → 景象；眼镜

words.en: to believe especially on uncertain or tentative grounds; talk over conjecturally, or review in an id
words.zh: 深思, 推测, 投机；投机
words.why: spec(看) + -ulate → 边看边琢磨 → 推测；投机

words.en: an ordered array of the components of an emission or wave; a broad range of related objects or value
words.zh: 光谱, 范围, 系列；光谱
words.why: spect(看) + -rum → 看到的一整串 → 光谱；范围

words.en: decide upon or fix definitely; determine the essential quality of
words.zh: 详列, 指定, 说明；指定
words.why: speci(种类) + -fy(使) → 指明是哪一类 → 指定

words.en: a medicine that has a mitigating effect on a specific disease
words.zh: 特效药, 特性；特殊的, 明确的, 具有特效的, 特定地, 具体地
words.why: speci(种类) + -fic → 定了类的 → 具体的

words.en: taxonomic group whose members can interbreed; a specific kind of something
words.zh: 种, 类, 外形；茶剂；种
words.why: speci(种类) → 同一类的生物 → 物种

words.en: an example regarded as typical of its class; a bit of tissue or blood or urine that is taken for dia
words.zh: 样品, 标本, 试料；试样
words.why: speci(种类) + -men → 同类里的样品 → 标本

words.en: contemplation of things past
words.zh: 回顾, 追忆, 回溯；回顾, 追忆
words.why: retro-(向后) + spect(看) → 向后看 → 回顾

words.en: the appearance of things relative to one another as determined by their distance from the viewer
words.zh: 远景, 透视感, (观察问题的)视角, 透视法, 看法, 透视图；透视的, 透视法的；透视
words.why: per-(透过) + spect(看) → 透过去看 → 视角；透视

words.en: heedful of potential consequences
words.zh: 细心的, 慎重的
words.why: circum-(环顾) + spect(看) → 四下都看了 → 谨慎的

words.en: obvious to the eye or mind
words.zh: 显著的, 显眼的, 出众的
words.why: con-(共同) + spic(看) → 大家都看得到 → 显眼的

words.en: look down on with disdain
words.zh: 轻视
words.why: de-(向下) + spis(看) → 看不上眼 → 轻视

words.en: a formal written offer to sell securities (filed with the SEC) that sets forth a plan for a (propose
words.zh: 创办计划书, (内容)说明书, 内容简介；(募债)说明书
words.why: pro-(向前) + spect(看) → 展望前路的册子 → 招股书

words.en: the contemplation of your own thoughts and desires and conduct
words.zh: 内省, 反省；内省
words.why: intro-(向内) + spect(看) → 向内看自己 → 内省

words.en: in spite of everything; without regard to drawbacks
words.zh: 不顾的, 无关的, 没关系的
words.why: ir-(不) + respect(看重) → 不论 → 不顾的

words.en: a detailed description of design criteria for a piece of work; naming explicitly
words.zh: 规格, 详述, 详细说明书；规范；形式说明；说明；说明书；规格
words.why: speci(种类) + -fy + -cation → 定类细则 → 规格

words.en: a high ranking police officer
words.zh: 检查员, 巡视员；检查员
words.why: in-(向内) + spect(看) + -or(人) → 检查员

words.en: concerned with or related to the past
words.zh: 回顾的, 怀旧的, 在后面的；回顾展
words.why: retro-(向后) + spect(看) → 回顾的

words.en: auguring favorable circumstances and good luck
words.zh: 吉兆的, 幸运的
words.why: aus(鸟) + spic(看) → 古罗马看鸟占卜得吉 → 吉兆的

origin: From Latin dicere / dictare 'to say, to speak repeatedly'.

words.en: make a prediction about; tell in advance
words.zh: 预知, 预言, 预报
words.why: pre-(预先) + dict(说) → 提前说 → 预言

words.en: capable of being foretold
words.zh: 可预言的
words.why: pre-(预先) + dict(说) + -able → 可预知的

words.en: the findings of a jury on issues of fact submitted to it for decision; can be used in formulating a
words.zh: 裁决, 判决, 判断性意见, 定论, 结论；定论, 判断, 意见
words.why: ver(真实) + dict(说) → 说出事实 → 裁决

words.en: an authoritative rule; a guiding principle
words.zh: 听写, 口述, 口授；口述, 使听写, 命令；命令, 指挥, 指令
words.why: dict(说) + -ate → 照着说 → 口述；命令

words.en: speech intended for reproduction in writing; matter that has been dictated and transcribed; a dictat
words.zh: 听写, 口述, 命令
words.why: dict(说) → 听写

words.en: a speaker who dictates to a secretary or a recording machine; a ruler who is unconstrained by law
words.zh: 命令者, 独裁者
words.why: dict(说) + -ator(人) → 说一不二的人 → 独裁者

words.en: be in contradiction with; deny the truth of
words.zh: 反驳, 与...抵触, 与...矛盾；反驳
words.why: contra-(相反) + dict(说) → 说反话 → 反驳

words.en: opposition between two conflicting forces or ideas; a statement that is necessarily false
words.zh: 反驳, 矛盾；矛盾, 否认, 反驳
words.why: contra-(相反) + dict(说) → 互相顶嘴 → 矛盾

words.en: accuse formally of a crime
words.zh: 起诉, 控告, 指控；控告, 揭发, 对...起诉
words.why: in-(对着) + dict(说) → 对着官方说 → 起诉

words.en: a formal document written for a prosecuting attorney charging a person with some offense; an accusat
words.zh: 起诉, 控告, 起诉状；起诉书
words.why: in-(对着) + dict(说) → 起诉书

words.en: a formal or authoritative proclamation
words.zh: 布告, 法令
words.why: e-(出) + dict(说) → 说出来的 → 法令

words.en: in law; the territory within which power can be exercised
words.zh: 司法权, 审判权, 管辖权；法律管辖权, 审判权
words.why: juris(法律) + dict(说) → 法律上说了算的地盘 → 管辖权

words.en: a ceremonial prayer invoking divine protection
words.zh: 祝福
words.why: bene-(好) + dict(说) → 说好话 → 祝福

words.en: the act of calling down a curse that invokes evil (and usually serves as an insult)
words.zh: 咒, 坏话
words.why: male-(坏) + dict(说) → 说坏话 → 诅咒

words.en: an authoritative declaration; an opinion voiced by a judge on a point of law not directly bearing on
words.zh: 声明, 格言, 法官意见；宣言, 声明, 法官的意见
words.why: dict(说) → 说出来的话 → 格言

words.en: someone who is so ardently devoted to something that it resembles an addiction; someone who is physi
words.zh: 使沉溺, 使上瘾；入迷的人, 上瘾者
words.why: ad-(向) + dict(说) → 被判给某物 → 上瘾

words.en: being abnormally tolerant to and dependent on something that is psychologically or physically habit-
words.zh: 入迷, 瘾；瘾, 癖嗜
words.why: ad-(向) + dict(说) → 被判给 → 瘾

words.en: commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country; an imported person brought from a for
words.zh: 进口货, 进口, 输入, 含义, 重要性；输入, 引入, 进口, 含...的意思, 重要；有关系；引入
words.why: im-(向内) + port(搬) → 运进来 → 进口

words.en: commodities (goods or services) sold to a foreign country
words.zh: 输出品, 输出；输出, 出口；输出物资；导出
words.why: ex-(向外) + port(搬) → 运出去 → 出口

words.en: an exchange of molecules (and their kinetic energy and momentum) across the boundary between adjacen
words.zh: 运输, 运输工具, 激动, 狂喜, 流放犯；传送, 运输, 流放；传送
words.why: trans-(越过) + port(搬) → 运过去 → 运输

words.en: a written document describing the findings of some individual or group; the act of informing by verb
words.zh: 报告, 报道, 传说, 案情报告, 爆炸声, 成绩单；报告, 汇报, 转述, 报道, 揭发, 使报到；报告, 写报道, 报到；报告
words.why: re-(回) + port(带) → 把消息带回 → 报告

words.en: the activity of providing for or maintaining by supplying with money or necessities; aiding the caus
words.zh: 支持, 支撑, 援助, 供养, 支撑物；支援, 支撑, 帮助, 支持, 忍受, 供养, 证实；后援；支持
words.why: sup-(从下) + port(撑) → 从下托住 → 支持

words.en: of great significance or value; having or suggesting a consciousness of high position
words.zh: 重要的, 有地位的, 大量的, 显要的, 自负的；要点
words.why: im-(向内) + port(搬) → 带进来有分量的 → 重要的

words.en: easily or conveniently transported; of a motor designed to be attached to the outside of a boat's hu
words.zh: 可携带的, 可搬运的, 可移动的；可移植的
words.why: port(搬) + -able → 搬得动的 → 便携的

words.en: a person employed to carry luggage and supplies; United States writer of novels and short stories (1
words.zh: 大楼管理员, 门房, 搬运工人, 侍者, 服务员；搬运车；搬运工人
words.why: port(搬) + -er(人) → 搬东西的人 → 搬运工

words.en: a large, flat, thin case for carrying loose papers or drawings or maps; usually leather; a set of pi
words.zh: 皮包, 公文包, 部长职务, 有价证券财产目录, 艺术代表作选辑；公文包, 文件夹, 阁员职务
words.why: port(搬) + folio(纸张) → 装纸的夹子 → 公文包

words.en: a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances
words.zh: 机会, 时机
words.why: ob-(对着) + port(港口) → 风向正对港口 → 顺风时机 → 机会

words.en: suitable or at a time that is suitable or advantageous especially for a particular purpose
words.zh: 恰好的, 时机适宜的, 适当的
words.why: ob-(对着) + port(港口) → 顺风的 → 及时的

words.en: behave in a certain manner; hand over to the authorities of another country
words.zh: 举止, 驱逐出境；放逐, 驱逐, 递解
words.why: de-(出去) + port(送) → 送出去 → 驱逐出境

words.en: the expulsion from a country of an undesirable alien
words.zh: 驱逐出境, 放逐；递解出境, 放逐, 驱逐
words.why: de-(出去) + port(送) → 驱逐出境

words.en: a relationship of mutual understanding or trust and agreement between people
words.zh: 关系, 融洽, 一致；关系, 协调(病人与医师间), 感通(唯心的灵交术时)
words.why: re-(回) + port(带) → 能带来回应 → 融洽关系

words.en: (behavioral attributes) the way a person behaves toward other people
words.zh: 行为, 举止
words.why: de-(离开) + port(带走) → 把自己带走的姿态 → 举止

words.en: an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition; the occupation of athletes who comp
words.zh: 运动, 游戏, 娱乐, 消遣, 玩笑；运动的, 户外穿戴的；游戏, 参加体育运动, 戏弄, 产生变种；炫耀, 使产生变种
words.why: dis-(分开) + port(搬) → 把正事搬开 → 娱乐；运动

words.en: furnishing support or assistance
words.zh: 支撑, 支承, 资助, 赞助, 支援, 经受, 忍受, 扶养, 证实, 鼓励, 维持, 伴奏
words.why: sup-(从下) + port(撑) → 从下托着的 → 支持的

words.en: someone whose business involves importing goods from outside (especially from a foreign country)
words.zh: 输入者, 进口商；进口商, 输入者
words.why: im-(向内) + port(搬) + -er → 进口商

words.en: a businessperson who transports goods abroad (for sale)
words.zh: 出口商, 输出者, 出口公司；出口商, 输出者
words.why: ex-(向外) + port(搬) + -er → 出口商

words.en: the act of moving something from one location to another; the commercial enterprise of moving goods
words.zh: 运输, 输送, 交通车辆；运转, 运输, 运输费
words.why: trans-(越过) + port(搬) → 运输

words.en: have the often specious appearance of being, intending, or claiming
words.zh: 意义, 要旨, 目的；意味着, 声称, 打算
words.why: pur-(向前) + port(送) → 送出去的主旨 → 意图

origin: From Latin jacere 'to throw' (past stem ject-).

words.en: refuse to accept or acknowledge; reject with contempt
words.zh: 被拒之人, 被弃之物, 不合格品, 次品；拒绝, 抵制, 否决, 驳回, 丢弃, 呕出
words.why: re-(回) + ject(扔) → 扔回去 → 拒绝

words.en: the act of rejecting something; the state of being rejected
words.zh: 拒绝, 抛弃, 驳回, 被抛弃的东西, 呕出物；报废；拒收
words.why: re-(回) + ject(扔) → 被扔回来 → 拒绝

words.en: a planned undertaking
words.zh: 计划, 设计, 事业；计划, 设计, 投掷, 发射, 使凸出, 放映；凸出
words.why: pro-(向前) + ject(扔) → 向前扔出 → 计划；投射

words.en: a prediction made by extrapolating from past observations; the projection of an image from a film on
words.zh: 发射, 计划, 突出部分, 设计, 推测；投影
words.why: pro-(向前) + ject(扔) → 投出去 → 投影；预测

words.en: give an injection to; to introduce (a new aspect or element)
words.zh: 注射, 注入, 使入轨；注射
words.why: in-(向内) + ject(扔) → 扔进去 → 注射

words.en: the forceful insertion of a substance under pressure; any solution that is injected (as into the ski
words.zh: 注射, 注射剂；注入；注射
words.why: in-(向内) + ject(扔) → 注射

words.en: put out or expel from a place; leave an aircraft rapidly, using an ejection seat or capsule
words.zh: 逐放, 放逐, 喷射；排出
words.why: e-(向外) + ject(扔) → 扔出去 → 弹出；驱逐

words.en: a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow; a constituent that is acted upon
words.zh: 物体, 目标, 目的, 对象, 宾语, 客体；反对, 抱反感；提出...来反对；对象
words.why: ob-(对着) + ject(扔) → 扔在面前的东西 → 物体；反对

words.en: the speech act of objecting; a procedure whereby a party to a suit says that a particular line of qu
words.zh: 异议, 反对, 不喜欢, 缺点, 缺陷, 妨碍, 拒绝之理由；异议, 反对, 抗议
words.why: ob-(对着) + ject(扔) → 扔向对方的异议 → 反对

words.en: the subject matter of a conversation or discussion; something (a person or object or scene) selected
words.zh: 科目, 主题, 臣民, 主语, 题目, (事物的)经受者, 学科, 受治疗者, 原因, 理由；服从的, 易患...的, 隶属的, 受支配的；在...条件下；使隶
words.why: sub-(在下面) + ject(扔) → 扔到麾下 → 主题；臣民

words.en: taking place within the mind and modified by individual bias
words.zh: 主观的, 个人的；主观的, 自觉的
words.why: sub-(在下面) + ject(扔) → 只在自己心里的 → 主观的

words.en: to insert between other elements
words.zh: 插嘴, 突然插入
words.why: inter-(中间) + ject(扔) → 扔进话缝 → 插嘴

words.en: a word that expresses an attribute of something; the word class that qualifies nouns
words.zh: 形容词；形容词的, 从属的
words.why: ad-(向) + ject(扔) → 扔到名词旁边的 → 形容词

words.en: the path followed by an object moving through space
words.zh: 轨道, 弹道, 轨线；轨道
words.why: tra-(穿过) + ject(扔) → 扔出去的路径 → 轨道

words.en: reasoning that involves the formation of conclusions from incomplete evidence
words.zh: 推测, 猜想, 揣摩；推测；猜测
words.why: con-(共同) + ject(扔) → 大家抛出想法 → 猜测

words.en: of the most contemptible kind; most unfortunate or miserable
words.zh: 绝望无助的, 可怜的, 糟透的, 卑鄙的, 自卑的；卑鄙的, 卑下的, 可怜的
words.why: ab-(离开) + ject(扔) → 被扔掉的 → 卑贱的

words.en: affected or marked by low spirits
words.zh: 沮丧的, 灰心的
words.why: de-(向下) + ject(扔) → 被摔在地上 → 沮丧的

words.en: throw away, of something encumbering; throw as from an airplane
words.zh: 投弃, 投弃货物；抛弃, 船货投海
words.why: jet(扔) → 把货扔下船 → 抛弃

words.en: an airplane powered by one or more jet engines; the occurrence of a sudden discharge (as of liquid)
words.zh: 喷射流, 喷嘴, 煤玉；射出, 迸出, 喷射；黑而发亮的, 墨黑的
words.why: ject(扔) → 喷出来的 → 喷射

origin: From Latin ducere 'to lead' (past stem duct-).

words.en: direct the course of; manage or control; lead, as in the performance of a composition; Barenboim con
words.zh: 行为, 举动, 指导；为人, 指挥, 管理, 实施；领导, 传导, 指挥
words.why: con-(共同) + duct(引) → 引到一起 → 指挥；管理

words.en: an artifact that has been created by someone or some process; a quantity obtained by multiplication
words.zh: 产品, 结果, 乘积；生产物
words.why: pro-(向前) + duct(引) → 引出来的东西 → 产品

words.en: fresh fruits and vegetable grown for the market
words.zh: 生产品, 物产, 后代；产生, 生产, 提出, 出示；生产, 制造
words.why: pro-(向前) + duc(引) → 引出来 → 生产

words.en: someone who finds financing for and supervises the making and presentation of a show (play or film o
words.zh: 生产者, 制作者, 制作人；发生器；(炉煤气)发生炉；制气炉；生产者
words.why: pro-(向前) + duc(引) + -er → 生产者

words.en: cut down on; make a reduction in; make less complex
words.zh: 减少, 分解, 降低, 使衰退, 把...分解, 把...归纳；减少, 减肥, 缩小；缩小
words.why: re-(回) + duc(引) → 引回原处 → 减少

words.en: any process in which electrons are added to an atom or ion (as by removing oxygen or adding hydrogen
words.zh: 减少, 缩影, 变化；还原
words.why: re-(回) + duc(引) → 减少

words.en: cause to come to know personally; bring something new to an environment
words.zh: 介绍, 引入, 采用, 输入；引进, 输入, 介绍
words.why: intro-(向内) + duc(引) → 引进来 → 介绍

words.en: the act of beginning something new; the first section of a communication
words.zh: 介绍, 传入, 采用, 初步
words.why: intro-(向内) + duc(引) → 引进 → 介绍

words.en: give an education to; teach or refine to be discriminative in taste or judgment
words.zh: 教育, 培养, 训练
words.why: e-(向外) + duc(引) → 把潜能引出来 → 教育

words.en: reason by deduction; establish by deduction; conclude by reasoning; in logic
words.zh: 推论, 演绎出；推断, 推出, 演绎
words.why: de-(向下) + duc(引) → 往下推 → 演绎出

words.en: make a subtraction; retain and refrain from disbursing; of payments
words.zh: 扣除, 减去；扣除, 减去, 折扣
words.why: de-(向下) + duct(引) → 往下减 → 扣除

words.en: an amount or percentage deducted; something that is inferred (deduced or entailed or implied)
words.zh: 减除, 扣除, 减除额, 推论；演绎, 推论
words.why: de-(向下) + duct(引) → 扣除；推论

words.en: cause to arise; cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner
words.zh: 引诱, 招致, 归纳出, 感应；诱导, 感应
words.why: in-(向内) + duc(引) → 引入 → 诱导；招致

words.en: arising from inductance; of reasoning; proceeding from particular facts to a general conclusion
words.zh: 归纳的, 感应的；感应瓦特计
words.why: in-(向内) + duc(引) → 引出规律的 → 归纳的

words.en: induce to have sex; lure or entice away from duty, principles, or proper conduct
words.zh: 唆使, 怂恿, 引诱, 诱奸；勾引, 诱惑, 诱奸
words.why: se-(离开) + duc(引) → 把人引走 → 诱惑

words.en: pull away from the body
words.zh: 诱拐, 绑架, 使外展；外展, 展
words.why: ab-(离开) + duct(引) → 引走 → 绑架

words.en: a bodily passage or tube lined with epithelial cells and conveying a secretion or other substance; a
words.zh: 管, 输送管；通过管道输送
words.why: duct(引) → 引流的管子 → 导管

words.en: a conduit that resembles a bridge but carries water over a valley
words.zh: 水管, 沟渠, 导管；水管
words.why: aque(水) + duct(引) → 引水的 → 水道桥

words.en: bridge consisting of a series of arches supported by piers used to carry a road (or railroad) over a
words.zh: 高架桥
words.why: via(路) + duct(引) → 引路跨谷 → 高架桥

words.en: place ceremoniously or formally in an office or position; admit as a member
words.zh: 引导, 使入门, 引入, 使就职
words.why: in-(向内) + duct(引) → 引入门 → 使就职

words.en: put down by force or intimidation; to put down by force or authority
words.zh: 使服从, 压制, 减弱, 抑制, 克制
words.why: sub-(向下) + duce(引) → 引到脚下 → 制服；削弱

words.en: a British peer of the highest rank; a nobleman (in various countries) of high rank
words.zh: 公爵
words.why: duc(引导者) → 带兵的人 → 公爵

words.en: tending to bring about; being partly responsible for
words.zh: 有益于...的, 有助于...的, 助长的
words.why: con-(共同) + duc(引) → 能引向好的 → 有助于

words.en: relating to logical deduction; involving inferences from general principles
words.zh: 推论的, 演绎的；推定的, 推断的, 演绎的
words.why: de-(向下) + duct(引) → 往下推的 → 演绎的

words.en: bad or dishonest management by persons supposed to act on another's behalf
words.zh: 办错, 使行为不端；办错, 渎职, 通奸
words.why: mis-(错) + conduct(引导) → 引错了 → 行为不端

words.en: a passage (a pipe or tunnel) through which water or electric wires can pass
words.zh: 导管, 水管, 沟渠；导管
words.why: con-(共同) + duit(引) → 引水的通道 → 导管
